findings.title: Specialist provenance mode and version are not validated
findings.reason: The validator accepts any provenance mode/version as long as symbol and scope match. The attach helper also replaces a pre-existing record after checking only symbol and direction. A same-symbol global or old-version island artifact can be accepted or silently relabeled, violating immutable specialist provenance and allowing incompatible cache contents to seed RB.
findings.recommendation: Require a dict with the exact specialist mode and supported provenance version, reject noncanonical pre-existing records before annotation, and validate the same contract for fresh and resumed entries.

findings.title: Island input identity degrades to row count after hash errors
findings.reason: _hash_island_frame catches every exception and returns rows:<count>. A changed same-sized frame can then satisfy the sidecar identity checks and warm-start from stale thresholds, despite the function claiming to bind the exact input slice.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed when exact hashing cannot be completed; do not use a row-count fallback for a cache identity.

findings.title: Malformed specialist metadata can crash standalone loading
findings.reason: validate_single_symbol_rule executes list(raw) for non-string scope metadata, so source_symbols=123 raises TypeError. drop_invalid_single_symbol_rules catches only ValueError, and _load_phase2_outputs does not catch the TypeError. A malformed but schema-valid pool therefore raises instead of being dropped fail-closed.
findings.recommendation: Validate metadata types and catch malformed metadata as a dropped entry in every resumed-entry filter.

findings.title: Public Phase 2 routing assumes configuration was validated by the caller
findings.reason: _run_phase2 selects global for any value other than specialist, and run_phase2 forwards directly to it without _validate_active_configuration. Direct public callers can therefore run an expensive global search under an invalid PHASE2_SYMBOL_MODE.
findings.recommendation: Validate or reject the resolved mode at the public Phase 2 entry point instead of silently defaulting invalid values to global.

findings.title: Artifact guard does not restore save_archive as a staticmethod
findings.reason: The guard captures Rule_Pool_Generator.save_archive after descriptor resolution and restores the bare function. After the first specialist island, instance access to this declared staticmethod becomes bound and can receive an unexpected self argument.
findings.recommendation: Capture and restore Rule_Pool_Generator.__dict__['save_archive'] or assign a staticmethod wrapper when restoring.
